desc: The versus ladder climbed to its end (TTYD_VERSUS_TEST=ladder on a finished file in Rogueport): a level 3 Mario with Super boots and hammer and Super-rank partners (moderun/versus_ladder.txt as versus.txt, no badges: with Normal gear he fell at rung 2 often enough to fail the rung 3 check; the ladder's Luigi still outgrows him a few rungs on) against each rung's computer Luigi, a level higher each rung, rung after rung on the next stage, every rung fought until Mario falls (the ladder's only end); Mario's side chosen by the versus computer too (TTYD_MODERUN_VERSUS_CPU, moderun_party_aurora.c; the auto battle's assists: his action commands and guards automatic), a few rungs won (Brotherly Rivalry, Bragging Rights), the best kept in versus_ladder.txt, then back in Rogueport with control, nothing lent, and the file as before (TTYD_MODERUN's checks); the run ends when the mode does. How many rungs Mario wins is the computers' to say (a guess: 4 to 10)
log_must: \[versus\] the fight starts: Mario \(level 3\) vs Luigi \(level 1\)
\[moderun\] check after Versus: stats same, partners same, badges same, items same, key items same, coins (\d+) -> \1, .*story same
